description: This file defines the EmergencyContact class in the OrangeHRM project, which extends ListableDisplayField and provides specific configurations for emergency contact report display, such as DTO class, entity aliases, and fields.

classes.name: EmergencyContact
classes.description: Represents the emergency contact display field configuration in the reporting system, specifying DTO class, entity aliases, and associated fields.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object (DTO) for emergency contact data.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Provides the entity alias used in reporting queries, here 'emergencyContact'.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the list of database fields related to the emergency contact report, here 'employee.empNumber'.
